wholly-owned subsidiary KS Smart Solutions bags a Rs 82.65 cr purchase order from Kerala State Electronics Development Corp (KELTRON) for smart-classroom installations across 1,799 classrooms, Rajasthan

order_wins: **Cochin Shipyard** -- signs a Rs 500 cr contract with the Ministry of Defence for normal refit cum re-powering of an Indian Naval Vessel, about two years (~1.6% of mcap).
**KS Smart Technologies** -- subsidiary KS Smart Solutions bags a Rs 82.65 cr purchase order from KELTRON for 1,799 smart classrooms in Rajasthan (~5.2% of mcap).
**Ashoka Buildcon** -- Letter of Acceptance from Druk Green Power, Bhutan, for the 120 MWp Wobthang solar plant, USD 58.90 mn, 18-month build; no rupee value given, so no mcap ratio.
**Z-Tech (India)** -- Rs 3.28 cr work order (incl. GST) from R&C Infraengineers for geotextile knitting on the NH116A Guskara-Katwa HAM corridor, West Bengal (SME, mcap not in store).
**Innovision** -- Letter of Award from NHAI worth Rs 12.17 cr to run user-fee collection at the Jagahedi Fee Plaza, Shamli-Muzaffarnagar NH-709AD, 90 days (~1.9% of mcap).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Regency Fincorp** (SME) -- EGM approves a preferential issue of Rs 72.05 cr equity and Rs 240.11 cr convertible warrants at Rs 50.50 each to promoter and public allottees (~41.9% of mcap).
**Aegis Logistics** -- opens its QIP with a floor price of Rs 1,161.85 a share (Board 28-Sep, shareholders 21-Oct); issue size is not stated in the filing.

**Tera Software** -- Board approves a preferential issue of convertible warrants to the promoter group, subject to shareholder approval; relevant date 11-Nov, size and price not stated in the pages read.
equity_allotments: **Vintage Coffee and Beverages** -- allots 39,00,000 fully convertible warrants to the promoter category at Rs 164 each, Rs 15.99 cr (fresh warrants).
m_and_a: **GP Petroleums** -- executes an SPA to buy 22.45% of Incubit Pipavav Terminal for up to Rs 44.27 cr, payable in tranches over a year (~13.2% of mcap).
**Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar** -- Board approves selling its 100% Singapore subsidiary to a Dubai consortium (Altaqat, Dejavu FZ) for USD 62,61,887, subject to regulatory approvals.
**Indo Borax & Chemicals** -- completes buying 64.26% of Kronox Lab Sciences and names Suresh Kalra its MD and CEO; the Board also approves merging a wholly owned subsidiary into itself.

**Warren Tea** -- certified copy received of the NCLT Kolkata order (5-Nov) sanctioning its amalgamation into Maple Hotels & Resorts; effective once filed with the RoC, record date for share allotment to follow.
**Oriental InfraTrust** -- Letter of Offer for an exit offer to dissenting unitholders for up to 75,32,962 units (1.29%) at Rs 113, about Rs 85.12 cr (our arithmetic).
**Tulsyan NEC** -- completes the sale of leasehold rights on 12,700 sq m of industrial land at Madkai, Goa, to Mangal Iron for Rs 3.81 cr, fully received.
capex_core: **Tata Power** -- Board approves a Rs 11,871 cr, 1,800 MW pumped-storage project at Shirwata, Maharashtra, funded 75% debt / 25% equity, 51-month build (~10.3% of mcap).
**HEG Advanced Materials** -- subsidiary TACC receives approval for a Rs 609.50 cr government incentive under ECMS for its synthetic-graphite anode project in Dewas.
business_updates: **JSW Steel** -- October 2026 consolidated crude-steel production rises 19% YoY to 25.73 lakh tonnes; Indian operations ran at 92% capacity utilisation.
**Popular Vehicles and Services** -- Q2FY27 consolidated new-vehicle volume rises 46.4% YoY to 19,052 units; total income up 36% YoY to Rs 2,093.8 cr.
**D.P. Abhushan** -- Navratri-to-Diwali festive-season sales rise 13.81% YoY to Rs 815.05 cr over a comparable 29 days; Dhanteras-day sales alone were Rs 143.86 cr.
**EAAA India Alternatives** -- first results since listing: H1FY27 PAT up 35% YoY to Rs 169 cr, fee-paying AUM Rs 49,164 cr (+28% YoY); interim dividend Rs 7 a share.
**Akiko Global Services** -- its AkikoPay platform passes 1,00,000 customers onboarded (management-reported, unaudited).
**ICICI Life Insurance** -- October 2026 annualised premium equivalent Rs 797 cr (Rs 7.97 bn per the filing, converted by us), 7-month FY27 APE Rs 5,732 cr, up 14.2% YoY.
distress_risk: **Radhagobind Commercial** -- Committee of Creditors approves the resolution plan by e-voting (4-Nov meeting); filed with NCLT Kolkata for sanction.
**TeleCanor Global** -- receives a Section 7 IBC petition (IB-156/7/HDB/2026) and says it will contest it through its already-filed Writ Petition 7800/2026.
open_offers: **IIFL Capital Services Limited** — FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd open offer — offer price not parsed from the PA; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 11,097 cr
other_notable: Shareholding disclosure: open-market share purchases by Promoter/Promoter Group members of **Awfis Space Solutions**.
